snippet.title: Kyuin  (キュイーン). [PlayStation]. 1CC. No Death. HARD. 60Fps.
snippet.description:
Kyuin  (キュイーン). [PlayStation]. 1CC. No Death. HARD. 60Fps.
:- Played By PiE.- "July 31st. 2020".
.
Some Boneheads say this game is crap... well i really enjoyed it, its easy fun and defo 8 outa ten from me :D
.
Archive.org - "Two kids are cleaning their room when they find a book of fairy tales. Suddenly a fairy pops out of the book and tells them about an evil wizard who is tampering the fairy tales. Hopping on the vacuum cleaner the kids travel to the fairy land to help the fairy."
